description: Catches AI-slop language patterns in UI copy and design proposals, then suggests rewrites. Specifically targets em-dashes connecting independent clauses, disclaimer-style colons, corporate verbs, redundant phrasing, and sentences trying to do too many jobs. Use before showing any user-facing copy to stakeholders.
